_comment: The Sorceress' kit, three schools of two. Damage is a multiplier on the caster's resolved hit rather than its own numbers, so affixes, sigils, inscriptions and boons all flow into every spell without any spell needing to know they exist. A spell decides shape, cost and element; core/damage.gd decides how much. Schools follow Diablo II's split — fire is steady, cold is steady and slows, lightning is a gamble — and the identity of each is in the numbers here, not in a special case anywhere in the code.

spells.name: Emberbolt
spells.description: The first thing anyone learns. Cheap, quick, unremarkable.

spells.name: Sunder
spells.description: Everything within reach, at once, at a price.

spells.name: Rimeshard
spells.description: Slower than an ember, and what it touches slows with it.

spells.name: Hoarfront
spells.description: The air gives up its heat all at once. Little damage; nothing leaves quickly.

spells.name: Arcspit
spells.description: Fast, cheap, and it will either tickle or erase.

spells.name: Stormbreak
spells.description: A held breath, then the whole room at once. Sometimes for nothing.
